chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
"If people were to partake in suhoor and then not break their fast except with water, they would be able to fast continuously throughout the year."

key_terms.الدَّهْرَ: the whole span of time, meaning continuously throughout the year
key_terms.الْمَاءِ: water, indicating simplicity in breaking the fast
key_terms.تَسَحَّرُوا: they took suhoor, the pre-dawn meal before fasting
key_terms.يُفْطِرُوا: they break the fast at iftar

ai.seo_question: How does suhoor and a simple iftar help a person endure fasting?
ai.summary: This hadith highlights the strengthening effect of suhoor and moderation in iftar. It indicates that simple nourishment and disciplined eating support endurance in fasting and worship.
